verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching this story is the /cardtransitions API, which sets the state of an existing card and is plausibly usable to block a compromised card, though the docs shown do not explicitly mention suspend or terminate states. Velocity controls, authorization controls and JIT funding are spend-control or developer building blocks, not fraud detection, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: network fraud scores or Marqeta fraud models surfaced at auth time, suspicious-activity alerts, documented card reissue for compromised cards, explicit block/suspend states, and any independent corroboration.
